channel.title: Haitian Dollar (HTD) | News & Updates
channel.description: Official announcements, product updates, and pilot milestones from Haitian Dollar Inc — an SEC CIK-registered entity (CIK 0001906040) building digital settlement infrastructure for the Haitian Dollar.

item.title: HTD Architecture Migrating to Base Layer 2 with Sub-Cent Settlement & Elastic Parity Engine
item.description: PORT-AU-PRINCE & BALTIMORE — Protocol framework finalized for partner merchants and diaspora senders. Elastic supply mirrors the Haitian Gourde reserve at the fixed 1 HTD = 5 HTG parity invariant with sub-cent mobile checkout.

item.title: Haitian Dollar Inc. Launches Automated Daily Market Rate Engine
item.description: BALTIMORE, MD — Haitian Dollar Inc. launches automated daily market rate engine pulling central bank (BRH) published foreign exchange figures directly into Base L2 infrastructure.

item.title: Haitian Dollar Inc. Issues Update to Prior Investors and Clarifies Regulatory Status
item.description: BALTIMORE, MD — Haitian Dollar Inc. (CIK 0001906040) today issued a formal update to prior investors, clarifying its closed offering status under Rule 506(b) and outlining architecture migration to Base L2.

item.title: Form D/A Filed With SEC
item.description: Haitian Dollar Inc files an amendment to its Form D under Rule 506(b) with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. CIK 0001906040 is publicly available on EDGAR for independent verification.

item.title: USPTO Registers Haitian Dollar Trademark
item.description: USPTO Reg. No. 6,267,276 (Serial No. 88319997) registered with the United States Patent and Trademark Office on the Principal Register for financial services and digital asset exchange. The Haitian Dollar mark is now a protected asset of Haitian Dollar Inc.

item.title: First Token Sale Completed
item.description: Initial issuance of HTD tokens completed. Form D/A reports the date of first sale as July 19, 2022.

item.title: Haitian Dollar Inc Incorporated in Maryland
item.description: Haitian Dollar Inc is incorporated in the State of Maryland as a C-Corporation, establishing the legal foundation for the project.

item.title: Haitian Dollar Whitepaper Published
item.description: Honson Luma publishes the first Haitian Dollar Whitepaper, laying out the historical foundation of the 1912 5:1 gourde peg and outlining the technology vision for the digital Haitian Dollar.

item.title: HTD Architecture Migrating to Modern On-Chain Infrastructure
item.description: HTD is being built on a modern on-chain environment with elastic supply — minted on deposit, burned on redemption. No fixed cap. Supply will mirror the Haitian Gourde reserve at a fixed 5:1 convention.

item.title: Pilot Framework in Development for Port-au-Prince
item.description: The Phase 1 pilot framework is being finalized for partner merchants and diaspora senders in Port-au-Prince. The program will allow users to buy, send, and redeem HTD at 1 HTD = 5 HTG.
